name: 新三国 · 候选次数 Top 20（被选 vs 跳过）
description: 数据源 run_history.completed → card_choices。堆叠条展示每张牌被选中与被跳过的绝对次数（同时看样本量与取舍倾向）。卡名见 analysis/posthog/report.md 的中文对照表。

source.query: SELECT JSONExtractString(choice, 'card', 'id') AS card_id, count() AS offered, countIf(JSONExtractBool(choice, 'was_picked')) AS picked, countIf(NOT JSONExtractBool(choice, 'was_picked')) AS skipped, round(countIf(JSONExtractBool(choice, 'was_picked')) / count(), 4) AS pick_rate FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(JSONExtractArrayRaw(stats, 'card_choices')) AS choice FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(JSONExtractArrayRaw(point, 'player_stats')) AS stats FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(JSONExtractArrayRaw(act_points)) AS point FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(JSONExtractArrayRaw(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractString(ifNull(properties.payload, ''), 'applicant_payload'), 'run_history'), 'map_point_history')) AS act_points FROM events WHERE event = 'run_history.completed')))) WHERE card_id != '' GROUP BY card_id ORDER BY offered DESC LIMIT 20
